GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn. ran on well along fence # too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of the mare, rider stated that he was satisfied with the manner in which his mount travelled throughout the event. However, in his opinion, the 1000m was too short for the mare today and he believed she would be better suited over further distances, at which she had previously performed well.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. hooked Wide turn 5 lengths. ran on well. # Even Effort
Slow Out 1/2 length Settled Down 4th 4 lengths. 4th turn 3 lengths. ran on well. peaked late # slow away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed suitable to start. After being fractious in the barriers underwent further veterinary examination and was passed suitable to race. Rider reported that his intention was to settle in a prominent position and lead the event, however, after being slow to begin was obliged to settle towards the rear of the field. He further added that his mount then raced one paced for the remainder of the event thereafter.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Rolled fwd & raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (2L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed out Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & challenged leaders @ 200m. Held ground late. # Wide/held ground.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was bumped on jumping by Star Empire. Raced three-wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat handy 2 Lengths off 3 Wide with cover, under pressure turn and dropped out # poor/amiss?
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance, rider could offer no tangible explanation. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the filly to have Cardiac Arrhythmia. Trainer was advised the result of an Electrocardiography, and a Cardiac Auscultation would be required prior to racing or trialling again. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well . Settled Down Two Wide 5th, 4 Lengths @ 600m. Hooked Out all Clear Straightening Up , wound up , Just missed # Sound in defeat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 50m was inclined to lay inwards while under pressure.
